## Epic-Norfolk analysis code: Physical Behaviour and Dementia

### Longitudinal analysis

Data set preparation
```{R data set prep}
# Merging separate disease columns into one
Valid.exp.3.4 <- Valid.exp.3.4 |> mutate(PREV_DISEASE = case_when(
  if_any(all_of(Disease_cols), ~ .x == "Yes") ~ 1,
  if_all(all_of(Disease_cols), is.na) ~ NA_real_,
  TRUE ~ 0))

Valid.exp.3.4$PREV_DISEASE <- ifelse(Valid.exp.3.4$PREV_DISEASE == 1, 1, 0)

Valid.exp.3.4 <- Valid.exp.3.4 |> mutate(PREV_DISEASE = factor(PREV_DISEASE,
                                                               levels = c(1,0),
                                                               labels = c("Yes", "No")))

# Dropping missing covariate data
FinalHC4 <- Valid.exp.3.4 |> drop_na(ETHNIC,
                                     EDLEVEL09, 
                                     RETIRED3, 
                                     URBANRURALSTATUS, 
                                     MARITAL_STATUS3, 
                                     ALT_BMI_HC3, 
                                     BP2,
                                     HEARING_FU4,
                                     UNITNOW3,
                                     CVA3,
                                     DM3,
                                     MI3,
                                     CA3)

# Follow-up column 
FinalHC4 <- FinalHC4 |> mutate(INC_DEMENTIA_ALL_NUM = recode_values(INC_DEMENTIA_ALL,
                                                                              "Dementia" ~ 1,
                                                                              "No dementia" ~ 0))

FinalHC4 <- FinalHC4|> mutate(INC_DEMENTIA_ALL_DATE_Y10TH = replace_na(INC_DEMENTIA_ALL_DATE_Y10TH, 0)) 

# For those with dementia, change EOF_Y10TH to incident dementia date, or retain EOF_Y10TH in those who are dementia free
FinalHC4 <- FinalHC4 |> mutate(EOF_Y10TH = if_else(INC_DEMENTIA_ALL_NUM == 1, #condition
                                                   INC_DEMENTIA_ALL_DATE_Y10TH, # if yes
                                                   EOF_Y10TH)) # otherwise
favstats(FinalHC4$DOC_HC4)

# Landmark analysis
FinalHC4 <- FinalHC4 |> mutate(HC4_FOLLOW_UP = if_else(EOF_Y10TH == 0, # condition
                                                       (2024.2 - DOC_HC4)/ 2, # if yes
                                                       (EOF_Y10TH - DOC_HC4))) # For those with null EOF, assume follow-up years as halfway between HC4 and study completion  

# HC3 physical behaviour variables
FinalHC4 <- FinalHC4 |> mutate(TPA3 = TOTAL_COUNTS_BOUTS_HC3/ TOTALWEAR_BOUTS_HC3,
                               MVPA3 = TOTAL_CUM_BT_MVPA_809_HC3/ VALID_DAYS_BOUTS_HC3,
                               LPA3 = TOTAL_CUM_BT_LPA_100_809_HC3/ VALID_DAYS_BOUTS_HC3,
                               ST3 = TOTAL_CUM_BT_SED_100_HC3/ VALID_DAYS_BOUTS_HC3,
                               SEDBOUT3 = TOT_BOUT_MT30_SED_100_HC3/ VALID_DAYS_BOUTS_HC3)

FinalHC4 <- FinalHC4 |> mutate(MVPA3_10min = MVPA3/10,
                               LPA3_10min = LPA3/10,
                               ST3_10min = ST3/10)

# HC4 physical behaviour variables
FinalHC4 <- FinalHC4 |> mutate(TPA4 = TOTAL_COUNTS_BOUTS_HC4/ TOTALWEAR_BOUTS_HC4,
                               MVPA4 =TOTAL_CUM_BT_MVPA_809_HC4/ VALID_DAYS_BOUTS_HC4,
                               LPA4 = TOTAL_CUM_BT_LPA_100_809_HC4/ VALID_DAYS_BOUTS_HC4, 
                               ST4 = TOTAL_CUM_BTIME_SED_100_HC4/ VALID_DAYS_BOUTS_HC4,
                               SEDBOUT4 = TOT_BOUT_MT30_SED_100_HC4/ VALID_DAYS_BOUTS_HC4)

FinalHC3 <- FinalHC4 |> mutate(MVPA4_10min = MVPA4/10,
                              LPA4_10min = LPA4/10,
                              ST4_10min = ST4/10)

FinalHC4 <- FinalHC4 |> mutate(FUDURATION = DOC_HC4 - DOC_HC3)


FinalHC4 <- FinalHC4 |> mutate(TPAchange = (TPA4 - TPA3)/ FUDURATION,
                               MVPAchange = (MVPA4 - MVPA3)/ FUDURATION,
                               LPAchange = (LPA4 - LPA3)/ FUDURATION,
                               STchange = (ST4 - ST3)/ FUDURATION,
                               SEDBOUTchange = (SEDBOUT4 - SEDBOUT3)/ FUDURATION)

summary(FinalHC4$TPAchange)

```


Description of HC4 participants
```{R description}
# How many participants had incident dementia
xtabs(~ INC_DEMENTIA_VASCULAR + INC_DEMENTIA_AD + INC_DEMENTIA_OTH, FinalHC4)
25/75*100
xtabs(~ INC_DEMENTIA_ALL_NUM + I(HC4_FOLLOW_UP < 0), FinalHC4)

# How many people had an unknown censor date
xtabs(~ EOF_Y10TH, FinalHC4 == 0)
14/1046*100
(16+7+1+15+1+8)/75*100

# How many people had negative follow-up
FinalHC4 <- FinalHC4 |> filter(HC4_FOLLOW_UP > 0) # 18 people had negative follow-up i.e. had dementia prior to second accelerometer measure
dim(FinalHC4)
favstats(FinalHC4$HC4_FOLLOW_UP)

# How many people were followed up for at least 4 years
FinalHC4test <- FinalHC4 |> filter(HC4_FOLLOW_UP > 4)
dim(FinalHC4test)
945/1027*100

# What was the median(IQR) duration between HC3 and HC4
FinalHC4 <- FinalHC4 |> mutate(FUDURATION = DOC_HC4 - DOC_HC3)
favstats(FinalHC4$FUDURATION)

# What was the median(IQR) age
favstats(FinalHC4$DOC_AGE_HC4)
describe(FinalHC4$DOC_HC4)

# What are the total person-years
sum(FinalHC4$HC4_FOLLOW_UP)

# How many people had accelerometer measures for seven days
xtabs(~ VALID_DAYS_BOUTS_HC4, FinalHC4)
```

## Survival analysis
```{R Survivor function}
# Survivor function
FinalHC4_Surv <- Surv(FinalHC4$HC4_FOLLOW_UP, FinalHC4$INC_DEMENTIA_ALL_NUM)

# KM plot

KM_Overall_FU <- survfit(FinalHC4_Surv ~ 1, data = FinalHC4)
plot(KM_Overall_FU, xlab = 'Years',
     ylab = 'Probability of survival (%)',
     main = 'Kaplan-Meier survivor function',
     mark.time=T, # tick marks at times when individuals are censored
     yscale =100) # survival expressed as percentage rather than probability
summary(KM_Overall_FU, times=c(1:20)) # probability of surviving up to year 17 is 83% (80.8 - 85.5% CI)
```

```{r Whole cohort survival analysis}

# ==============================================================================
#                               MODEL 1: UNADJUSTED
# ==============================================================================

# Model 1.1: Annual TPA change (cpm/year)

Cox_TPAchange <- coxph(FinalHC4_Surv ~ TPAchange, data = FinalHC4)
ACTPAzph <- cox.zph(Cox_TPAchange)
plot(ACTPAzph)
ACTPAzph # Schoenfield's residual non significant

Cox_TPAchange.tbl <- tbl_regression(Cox_TPAchange, exponentiate = TRUE,
                                    label = list(TPAchange = "TPA (cpm/year)"))

# Model 1.2: Annual MVPA change (min/d/yr)

Cox_MVPAchange <- coxph(FinalHC4_Surv ~ MVPAchange, data = FinalHC4)
ACMVPAzph <- cox.zph(Cox_MVPAchange)
plot(ACMVPAzph)
ACMVPAzph # SR non-signif

Cox_MVPAchange.tbl <- tbl_regression(Cox_MVPAchange, exponentiate = TRUE,
                                    label = list(MVPAchange = "MVPA (min/d/yr)"))

# Model 1.3: Annual LPA change (min/d/yr)
Cox_LPAchange <- coxph(FinalHC4_Surv ~ LPAchange, data = FinalHC4)
ACLPAzph <- cox.zph(Cox_LPAchange)
plot(ACLPAzph)
ACLPAzph # Significant (0.0056)

Cox_LPAchange.tbl <- tbl_regression(Cox_LPAchange, exponentiate = TRUE,
                                     label = list(LPAchange = "LPA (min/d/yr)"))

# Model 1.4: Annual ST change (min/d/yr)
Cox_STchange <- coxph(FinalHC4_Surv ~ STchange, data = FinalHC4)
ACSTzph <- cox.zph(Cox_STchange)
plot(ACSTzph)
ACSTzph # Non-significant

Cox_STchange.tbl <- tbl_regression(Cox_STchange, exponentiate = TRUE,
                                    label = list(STchange = "ST (min/d/yr)"))

# Model 1.5: Annual SEDBOUT change (min/d/yr)
Cox_SEDBOUTchange <- coxph(FinalHC4_Surv ~ SEDBOUTchange, data = FinalHC4)
ACSBzph <- cox.zph(Cox_SEDBOUTchange)
plot(ACSBzph)
ACSBzph # Non-significant

Cox_SEDBOUTchange.tbl <- tbl_regression(Cox_SEDBOUTchange, exponentiate = TRUE,
                                   label = list(SEDBOUTchange = "Sedentary bouts (min/d/yr)"))


# Merged coxph table for MODEL 0: UNADJUSTED
All_unadj_FU <- tbl_stack(
  tbls = list(Cox_TPAchange.tbl,  Cox_MVPAchange.tbl,  Cox_LPAchange.tbl, Cox_STchange.tbl, Cox_SEDBOUTchange.tbl))|> 
  bold_p(t = 0.05) |>  modify_header(label = "**Annual Physical Behaviour Change**")
All_unadj_FU


# ==============================================================================
#                      MODEL 2: All Age and sex Adjusted 
# ==============================================================================


M2_TPA <- coxph(FinalHC4_Surv ~ TPAchange + FEMALE + DOC_AGE_HC4, data = FinalHC4)
M2_TPA.tbl <- tbl_regression(M2_TPA, exponentiate = TRUE, include = "TPAchange",
                             label = list(TPAchange = "TPA (cpm/year)"))
                                    

M2_MVPA <- coxph(FinalHC4_Surv ~ MVPAchange + FEMALE + DOC_AGE_HC4, data = FinalHC4)
M2_MVPA.tbl <- tbl_regression(M2_MVPA, exponentiate = TRUE, include = "MVPAchange",
                              label = list(MVPAchange = "MVPA (min/d/yr)"))


M2_LPA <- coxph(FinalHC4_Surv ~ LPAchange + FEMALE + DOC_AGE_HC4, data = FinalHC4)
M2_LPA.tbl <- tbl_regression(M2_LPA, exponentiate = TRUE, include = "LPAchange",
                             label = list(LPAchange = "LPA (min/d/yr)"))


M2_ST <- coxph(FinalHC4_Surv ~ STchange + FEMALE + DOC_AGE_HC4, data = FinalHC4)
M2_ST.tbl <- tbl_regression(Cox_STchange, exponentiate = TRUE, include = "STchange",
                                   label = list(STchange = "ST (min/d/yr)"))


M2_SEDBOUT <- coxph(FinalHC4_Surv ~ SEDBOUTchange + FEMALE + DOC_AGE_HC4, data = FinalHC4)
M2_SEDBOUT.tbl <- tbl_regression(Cox_SEDBOUTchange, exponentiate = TRUE, include = "SEDBOUTchange",
                                        label = list(SEDBOUTchange = "Sedentary bouts (min/d/yr)"))


All_age_sex.adj <- tbl_stack(
  tbls = list(M2_TPA.tbl, M2_MVPA.tbl, M2_LPA.tbl, M2_ST.tbl, M2_SEDBOUT.tbl)
) |>   bold_p(t = 0.05) |>  modify_header(label = "**Minimally Adjusted**")

All_age_sex.adj

# ==============================================================================
#                     MODEL 3: All Covariate Adjusted 
# ==============================================================================

Disease_cols <- c("CA3", "DM3", "MI3", "CVA3")

FinalHC4 <- FinalHC4 |> mutate(PREV_DISEASE = case_when(
  if_any(all_of(Disease_cols), ~ .x == "Yes") ~ 1,
  if_all(all_of(Disease_cols), is.na) ~ NA_real_,
  TRUE ~ 0))

FinalHC4$PREV_DISEASE <- ifelse(FinalHC4$PREV_DISEASE == 1, 1, 0)
FinalHC4 <- FinalHC4 |> mutate(PREV_DISEASE = factor(PREV_DISEASE,
                                                     levels = c(1,0),
                                                     labels = c("Yes", "No")))

#CIGSTAT3 removed because confidence intervals too wide
covariates_list <- ~ FEMALE + DOC_AGE_HC4 + EDLEVEL09 + RETIRED3 + 
                     URBANRURALSTATUS + UNITNOW3 + 
                     MARITAL_STATUS3 + ALT_BMI_HC3 + BP2 + 
                     HEARING_FU4 + PREV_DISEASE


# Model 3.1: Annual TPA change (cpm/year)
Cox_AdjTPAchange2 <- coxph(FinalHC4_Surv ~ TPAchange + 
                             TPA3 +
                             covariates_list, data = FinalHC4)

Cox_AdjTPAchange2.tbl <- tbl_regression(Cox_AdjTPAchange2, exponentiate = TRUE, include = "TPAchange",
                                    label = list(TPAchange = "TPA (cpm/year)"))

# Model 2.2: Annual MVPA change (min/d/yr)
Cox_AdjMVPAchange2 <- coxph(FinalHC4_Surv ~ MVPAchange + 
                              MVPA3 +
                             covariates_list, data = FinalHC4)

Cox_AdjMVPAchange2.tbl <- tbl_regression(Cox_AdjMVPAchange2, exponentiate = TRUE, include = "MVPAchange",
                                     label = list(MVPAchange = "MVPA (min/d/yr)"))
summary(Cox_AdjMVPAchange2)

# Model 2.3: Annual LPA change (min/d/yr)
Cox_AdjLPAchange2 <- coxph(FinalHC4_Surv ~ LPAchange +
                             LPA3 +
                            covariates_list, data = FinalHC4)
Cox_AdjLPAchange2.tbl <- tbl_regression(Cox_AdjLPAchange2, exponentiate = TRUE, include = "LPAchange",
                                    label = list(LPAchange = "LPA (min/d/yr)"))

# Model 2.4: Annual ST change (min/d/yr)
Cox_AdjSTchange2 <- coxph(FinalHC4_Surv ~ STchange + 
                            ST3 +
                           covariates_list, data = FinalHC4)
Cox_AdjSTchange2.tbl <- tbl_regression(Cox_AdjSTchange2, exponentiate = TRUE, include = "STchange",
                                   label = list(STchange = "ST (min/d/yr)"))

# Model 2.5: Annual SEDBOUT change (min/d/yr)
Cox_AdjSEDBOUTchange2 <- coxph(FinalHC4_Surv ~ SEDBOUTchange + 
                                 SEDBOUT3 +
                                covariates_list, data = FinalHC4)

Cox_AdjSEDBOUTchange2.tbl <- tbl_regression(Cox_AdjSEDBOUTchange2, exponentiate = TRUE, include = "SEDBOUTchange",
                                        label = list(SEDBOUTchange = "Sedentary bouts (min/d/yr)"))

# Merged coxph table for MODEL 2: Adjusted
All_Adj2_FU <- tbl_stack(
  tbls = list(Cox_AdjTPAchange2.tbl,  Cox_AdjMVPAchange2.tbl,  Cox_AdjLPAchange2.tbl, Cox_AdjSTchange2.tbl, Cox_AdjSEDBOUTchange2.tbl))|> 
  bold_p(t = 0.05) |>  modify_header(label = "**Model 2 (All Covariate Adjusted): Annual Physical Behaviour Change**")
All_Adj2_FU
```

Table for whole cohort Cox models
```{R Whole cohort table}
All_HC4cox.tbl <- tbl_merge(
  tbls = list(All_unadj_FU, All_age_sex.adj, All_Adj2_FU),
  tab_spanner = c("**Unadjusted**", "**Minimally Adjusted**", "**Fully Adjusted**") 
)

print(All_HC4cox.tbl)
```

###Sensitivity analysis
```{r, excluding participants with dementia in first 2 years}
FinalHC4_nodem2 <- FinalHC4 |> filter(!(INC_DEMENTIA_ALL_NUM == 1 & HC4_FOLLOW_UP <= 2))
dim(FinalHC4_nodem2)

# Survivor function = time, event
FinalHC4_nodem2_Surv <- Surv(FinalHC4_nodem2$HC4_FOLLOW_UP, FinalHC4_nodem2$INC_DEMENTIA_ALL_NUM)
FinalHC4_nodem2_Surv

covariates_list_nodem2 <- ~ FEMALE + DOC_AGE_HC4 + EDLEVEL09 + RETIRED3 + 
                            URBANRURALSTATUS + UNITNOW3 + 
                            MARITAL_STATUS3 + ALT_BMI_HC3 + BP2 + 
                            HEARING_FU4 + PREV_DISEASE

# ==============================================================================
# MODEL 1: UNADJUSTED (FinalHC4_nodem2)
# ==============================================================================

Cox_TPAchange_nodem2 <- coxph(FinalHC4_nodem2_Surv ~ TPAchange, data = FinalHC4_nodem2)
Cox_TPAchange_nodem2.tbl <- tbl_regression(Cox_TPAchange_nodem2, exponentiate = TRUE,
                                            label = list(TPAchange = "TPA (cpm/year)"))

Cox_MVPAchange_nodem2 <- coxph(FinalHC4_nodem2_Surv ~ MVPAchange, data = FinalHC4_nodem2)
Cox_MVPAchange_nodem2.tbl <- tbl_regression(Cox_MVPAchange_nodem2, exponentiate = TRUE,
                                             label = list(MVPAchange = "MVPA (min/d/yr)"))

Cox_LPAchange_nodem2 <- coxph(FinalHC4_nodem2_Surv ~ LPAchange, data = FinalHC4_nodem2)
Cox_LPAchange_nodem2.tbl <- tbl_regression(Cox_LPAchange_nodem2, exponentiate = TRUE,
                                            label = list(LPAchange = "LPA (min/d/yr)"))

Cox_STchange_nodem2 <- coxph(FinalHC4_nodem2_Surv ~ STchange, data = FinalHC4_nodem2)
Cox_STchange_nodem2.tbl <- tbl_regression(Cox_STchange_nodem2, exponentiate = TRUE,
                                           label = list(STchange = "ST (min/d/yr)"))

Cox_SEDBOUTchange_nodem2 <- coxph(FinalHC4_nodem2_Surv ~ SEDBOUTchange, data = FinalHC4_nodem2)
Cox_SEDBOUTchange_nodem2.tbl <- tbl_regression(Cox_SEDBOUTchange_nodem2, exponentiate = TRUE,
                                               label = list(SEDBOUTchange = "Sedentary bouts (min/d/yr)"))

All_unadj_FU_nodem2 <- tbl_stack(
  tbls = list(Cox_TPAchange_nodem2.tbl, Cox_MVPAchange_nodem2.tbl, Cox_LPAchange_nodem2.tbl, 
              Cox_STchange_nodem2.tbl, Cox_SEDBOUTchange_nodem2.tbl)
) |> bold_p(t = 0.05) |> modify_header(label = "**Annual Physical Behaviour Change**")


# ==============================================================================
# MODEL 2: AGE AND SEX ADJUSTED (FinalHC4_nodem2)
# ==============================================================================

M2_TPA_nodem2 <- coxph(FinalHC4_nodem2_Surv ~ TPAchange + FEMALE + DOC_AGE_HC4, data = FinalHC4_nodem2)
M2_TPA_nodem2.tbl <- tbl_regression(M2_TPA_nodem2, exponentiate = TRUE, include = "TPAchange",
                                     label = list(TPAchange = "TPA (cpm/year)"))

M2_MVPA_nodem2 <- coxph(FinalHC4_nodem2_Surv ~ MVPAchange + FEMALE + DOC_AGE_HC4, data = FinalHC4_nodem2)
M2_MVPA_nodem2.tbl <- tbl_regression(M2_MVPA_nodem2, exponentiate = TRUE, include = "MVPAchange",
                                      label = list(MVPAchange = "MVPA (min/d/yr)"))

M2_LPA_nodem2 <- coxph(FinalHC4_nodem2_Surv ~ LPAchange + FEMALE + DOC_AGE_HC4, data = FinalHC4_nodem2)
M2_LPA_nodem2.tbl <- tbl_regression(M2_LPA_nodem2, exponentiate = TRUE, include = "LPAchange",
                                     label = list(LPAchange = "LPA (min/d/yr)"))

M2_ST_nodem2 <- coxph(FinalHC4_nodem2_Surv ~ STchange + FEMALE + DOC_AGE_HC4, data = FinalHC4_nodem2)
M2_ST_nodem2.tbl <- tbl_regression(M2_ST_nodem2, exponentiate = TRUE, include = "STchange",
                                    label = list(STchange = "ST (min/d/yr)"))

M2_SEDBOUT_nodem2 <- coxph(FinalHC4_nodem2_Surv ~ SEDBOUTchange + FEMALE + DOC_AGE_HC4, data = FinalHC4_nodem2)
M2_SEDBOUT_nodem2.tbl <- tbl_regression(M2_SEDBOUT_nodem2, exponentiate = TRUE, include = "SEDBOUTchange",
                                         label = list(SEDBOUTchange = "Sedentary bouts (min/d/yr)"))

All_age_sex_nodem2.adj <- tbl_stack(
  tbls = list(M2_TPA_nodem2.tbl, M2_MVPA_nodem2.tbl, M2_LPA_nodem2.tbl, 
              M2_ST_nodem2.tbl, M2_SEDBOUT_nodem2.tbl)
) |> bold_p(t = 0.05) |> modify_header(label = "**Minimally Adjusted**")


# ==============================================================================
# MODEL 3: FULLY COVARIATE ADJUSTED + BASELINE VALUE (FinalHC4_nodem2)
# ==============================================================================

Cox_AdjTPAchange2_nodem2 <- coxph(update.formula(FinalHC4_nodem2_Surv ~ TPAchange + TPA3, covariates_list_nodem2), data = FinalHC4_nodem2)
Cox_AdjTPAchange2_nodem2.tbl <- tbl_regression(Cox_AdjTPAchange2_nodem2, exponentiate = TRUE, include = "TPAchange",
                                                label = list(TPAchange = "TPA (cpm/year)"))

Cox_AdjMVPAchange2_nodem2 <- coxph(update.formula(FinalHC4_nodem2_Surv ~ MVPAchange + MVPA3, covariates_list_nodem2), data = FinalHC4_nodem2)
Cox_AdjMVPAchange2_nodem2.tbl <- tbl_regression(Cox_AdjMVPAchange2_nodem2, exponentiate = TRUE, include = "MVPAchange",
                                                 label = list(MVPAchange = "MVPA (min/d/yr)"))

Cox_AdjLPAchange2_nodem2 <- coxph(update.formula(FinalHC4_nodem2_Surv ~ LPAchange + LPA3, covariates_list_nodem2), data = FinalHC4_nodem2)
Cox_AdjLPAchange2_nodem2.tbl <- tbl_regression(Cox_AdjLPAchange2_nodem2, exponentiate = TRUE, include = "LPAchange",
                                                label = list(LPAchange = "LPA (min/d/yr)"))

Cox_AdjSTchange2_nodem2 <- coxph(update.formula(FinalHC4_nodem2_Surv ~ STchange + ST3, covariates_list_nodem2), data = FinalHC4_nodem2)
Cox_AdjSTchange2_nodem2.tbl <- tbl_regression(Cox_AdjSTchange2_nodem2, exponentiate = TRUE, include = "STchange",
                                               label = list(STchange = "ST (min/d/yr)"))

Cox_AdjSEDBOUTchange2_nodem2 <- coxph(update.formula(FinalHC4_nodem2_Surv ~ SEDBOUTchange + SEDBOUT3, covariates_list_nodem2), data = FinalHC4_nodem2)
Cox_AdjSEDBOUTchange2_nodem2.tbl <- tbl_regression(Cox_AdjSEDBOUTchange2_nodem2, exponentiate = TRUE, include = "SEDBOUTchange",
                                                    label = list(SEDBOUTchange = "Sedentary bouts (min/d/yr)"))

All_Adj2_FU_nodem2 <- tbl_stack(
  tbls = list(Cox_AdjTPAchange2_nodem2.tbl, Cox_AdjMVPAchange2_nodem2.tbl, Cox_AdjLPAchange2_nodem2.tbl, 
              Cox_AdjSTchange2_nodem2.tbl, Cox_AdjSEDBOUTchange2_nodem2.tbl)
) |> bold_p(t = 0.05) |> modify_header(label = "**Fully Adjusted**")


# ==============================================================================
# MERGED SUMMARY TABLE (FinalHC4_nodem2)
# ==============================================================================
All_HC4_nodem2_cox.tbl <- tbl_merge(
  tbls = list(All_unadj_FU_nodem2, All_age_sex_nodem2.adj, All_Adj2_FU_nodem2),
  tab_spanner = c("**Unadjusted**", "**Minimally Adjusted**", "**Fully Adjusted**") 
) |> modify_header(label = "Annual Physical Behaviour Change (Excl. <2yr Dementia)")

print(All_HC4_nodem2_cox.tbl)
```

### Sensitivity analysis: excluding participants with dementia in first 5 years
```{r, excluding participants with dementia in first 5 years}
FinalHC4_nodem5 <- FinalHC4 |> filter(!(INC_DEMENTIA_ALL_NUM == 1 & HC4_FOLLOW_UP <= 5))
dim(FinalHC4_nodem5)

# Survivor function = time, event
FinalHC4_nodem5_Surv <- Surv(FinalHC4_nodem5$HC4_FOLLOW_UP, FinalHC4_nodem5$INC_DEMENTIA_ALL_NUM)
FinalHC4_nodem5_Surv

covariates_list_nodem5 <- ~ FEMALE + DOC_AGE_HC4 + EDLEVEL09 + RETIRED3 + 
                            URBANRURALSTATUS + UNITNOW3 + 
                            MARITAL_STATUS3 + ALT_BMI_HC3 + BP2 + 
                            HEARING_FU4 + PREV_DISEASE

# ==============================================================================
# MODEL 1: UNADJUSTED (FinalHC4_nodem5)
# ==============================================================================

Cox_TPAchange_nodem5 <- coxph(FinalHC4_nodem5_Surv ~ TPAchange, data = FinalHC4_nodem5)
Cox_TPAchange_nodem5.tbl <- tbl_regression(Cox_TPAchange_nodem5, exponentiate = TRUE,
                                            label = list(TPAchange = "TPA (cpm/year)"))

Cox_MVPAchange_nodem5 <- coxph(FinalHC4_nodem5_Surv ~ MVPAchange, data = FinalHC4_nodem5)
Cox_MVPAchange_nodem5.tbl <- tbl_regression(Cox_MVPAchange_nodem5, exponentiate = TRUE,
                                             label = list(MVPAchange = "MVPA (min/d/yr)"))

Cox_LPAchange_nodem5 <- coxph(FinalHC4_nodem5_Surv ~ LPAchange, data = FinalHC4_nodem5)
Cox_LPAchange_nodem5.tbl <- tbl_regression(Cox_LPAchange_nodem5, exponentiate = TRUE,
                                            label = list(LPAchange = "LPA (min/d/yr)"))

Cox_STchange_nodem5 <- coxph(FinalHC4_nodem5_Surv ~ STchange, data = FinalHC4_nodem5)
Cox_STchange_nodem5.tbl <- tbl_regression(Cox_STchange_nodem5, exponentiate = TRUE,
                                           label = list(STchange = "ST (min/d/yr)"))

Cox_SEDBOUTchange_nodem5 <- coxph(FinalHC4_nodem5_Surv ~ SEDBOUTchange, data = FinalHC4_nodem5)
Cox_SEDBOUTchange_nodem5.tbl <- tbl_regression(Cox_SEDBOUTchange_nodem5, exponentiate = TRUE,
                                               label = list(SEDBOUTchange = "Sedentary bouts (min/d/yr)"))

All_unadj_FU_nodem5 <- tbl_stack(
  tbls = list(Cox_TPAchange_nodem5.tbl, Cox_MVPAchange_nodem5.tbl, Cox_LPAchange_nodem5.tbl, 
              Cox_STchange_nodem5.tbl, Cox_SEDBOUTchange_nodem5.tbl)
) |> bold_p(t = 0.05) |> modify_header(label = "**Annual Physical Behaviour Change**")


# ==============================================================================
# MODEL 2: AGE AND SEX ADJUSTED (FinalHC4_nodem5)
# ==============================================================================

M2_TPA_nodem5 <- coxph(FinalHC4_nodem5_Surv ~ TPAchange + FEMALE + DOC_AGE_HC4, data = FinalHC4_nodem5)
M2_TPA_nodem5.tbl <- tbl_regression(M2_TPA_nodem5, exponentiate = TRUE, include = "TPAchange",
                                     label = list(TPAchange = "TPA (cpm/year)"))

M2_MVPA_nodem5 <- coxph(FinalHC4_nodem5_Surv ~ MVPAchange + FEMALE + DOC_AGE_HC4, data = FinalHC4_nodem5)
M2_MVPA_nodem5.tbl <- tbl_regression(M2_MVPA_nodem5, exponentiate = TRUE, include = "MVPAchange",
                                      label = list(MVPAchange = "MVPA (min/d/yr)"))

M2_LPA_nodem5 <- coxph(FinalHC4_nodem5_Surv ~ LPAchange + FEMALE + DOC_AGE_HC4, data = FinalHC4_nodem5)
M2_LPA_nodem5.tbl <- tbl_regression(M2_LPA_nodem5, exponentiate = TRUE, include = "LPAchange",
                                     label = list(LPAchange = "LPA (min/d/yr)"))

M2_ST_nodem5 <- coxph(FinalHC4_nodem5_Surv ~ STchange + FEMALE + DOC_AGE_HC4, data = FinalHC4_nodem5)
M2_ST_nodem5.tbl <- tbl_regression(M2_ST_nodem5, exponentiate = TRUE, include = "STchange",
                                    label = list(STchange = "ST (min/d/yr)"))

M2_SEDBOUT_nodem5 <- coxph(FinalHC4_nodem5_Surv ~ SEDBOUTchange + FEMALE + DOC_AGE_HC4, data = FinalHC4_nodem5)
M2_SEDBOUT_nodem5.tbl <- tbl_regression(M2_SEDBOUT_nodem5, exponentiate = TRUE, include = "SEDBOUTchange",
                                         label = list(SEDBOUTchange = "Sedentary bouts (min/d/yr)"))

All_age_sex_nodem5.adj <- tbl_stack(
  tbls = list(M2_TPA_nodem5.tbl, M2_MVPA_nodem5.tbl, M2_LPA_nodem5.tbl, 
              M2_ST_nodem5.tbl, M2_SEDBOUT_nodem5.tbl)
) |> bold_p(t = 0.05) |> modify_header(label = "**Minimally Adjusted**")


# ==============================================================================
# MODEL 3: FULLY COVARIATE ADJUSTED + BASELINE VALUE (FinalHC4_nodem5)
# ==============================================================================

Cox_AdjTPAchange2_nodem5 <- coxph(update.formula(FinalHC4_nodem5_Surv ~ TPAchange + TPA3, covariates_list_nodem5), data = FinalHC4_nodem5)
Cox_AdjTPAchange2_nodem5.tbl <- tbl_regression(Cox_AdjTPAchange2_nodem5, exponentiate = TRUE, include = "TPAchange",
                                                label = list(TPAchange = "TPA (cpm/year)"))

Cox_AdjMVPAchange2_nodem5 <- coxph(update.formula(FinalHC4_nodem5_Surv ~ MVPAchange + MVPA3, covariates_list_nodem5), data = FinalHC4_nodem5)
Cox_AdjMVPAchange2_nodem5.tbl <- tbl_regression(Cox_AdjMVPAchange2_nodem5, exponentiate = TRUE, include = "MVPAchange",
                                                 label = list(MVPAchange = "MVPA (min/d/yr)"))

Cox_AdjLPAchange2_nodem5 <- coxph(update.formula(FinalHC4_nodem5_Surv ~ LPAchange + LPA3, covariates_list_nodem5), data = FinalHC4_nodem5)
Cox_AdjLPAchange2_nodem5.tbl <- tbl_regression(Cox_AdjLPAchange2_nodem5, exponentiate = TRUE, include = "LPAchange",
                                                label = list(LPAchange = "LPA (min/d/yr)"))

Cox_AdjSTchange2_nodem5 <- coxph(update.formula(FinalHC4_nodem5_Surv ~ STchange + ST3, covariates_list_nodem5), data = FinalHC4_nodem5)
Cox_AdjSTchange2_nodem5.tbl <- tbl_regression(Cox_AdjSTchange2_nodem5, exponentiate = TRUE, include = "STchange",
                                               label = list(STchange = "ST (min/d/yr)"))

Cox_AdjSEDBOUTchange2_nodem5 <- coxph(update.formula(FinalHC4_nodem5_Surv ~ SEDBOUTchange + SEDBOUT3, covariates_list_nodem5), data = FinalHC4_nodem5)
Cox_AdjSEDBOUTchange2_nodem5.tbl <- tbl_regression(Cox_AdjSEDBOUTchange2_nodem5, exponentiate = TRUE, include = "SEDBOUTchange",
                                                    label = list(SEDBOUTchange = "Sedentary bouts (min/d/yr)"))

All_Adj2_FU_nodem5 <- tbl_stack(
  tbls = list(Cox_AdjTPAchange2_nodem5.tbl, Cox_AdjMVPAchange2_nodem5.tbl, Cox_AdjLPAchange2_nodem5.tbl, 
              Cox_AdjSTchange2_nodem5.tbl, Cox_AdjSEDBOUTchange2_nodem5.tbl)
) |> bold_p(t = 0.05) |> modify_header(label = "**Fully Adjusted**")


# ==============================================================================
# MERGED SUMMARY TABLE (FinalHC4_nodem5)
# ==============================================================================
All_HC4_nodem5_cox.tbl <- tbl_merge(
  tbls = list(All_unadj_FU_nodem5, All_age_sex_nodem5.adj, All_Adj2_FU_nodem5),
  tab_spanner = c("**Unadjusted**", "**Minimally Adjusted**", "**Fully Adjusted**") 
) |> modify_header(label = "Annual Physical Behaviour Change (Excl. <5yr Dementia)")

print(All_HC4_nodem5_cox.tbl)
```
